time.expression: At most 448 n^3 log₂(n) + 4090 n^3 logical Toffoli gates

space.expression: At most 9n + 2 ceil(log₂ n) + 10 logical qubits

notes: Resource estimate for a specific quantum circuit over an n-bit prime field. Counts logical gates and qubits; excludes physical error correction. This is a proved circuit bound rather than a measured quantum attack.
